items.title: Singing from a Shared Songbook
items.alt: Three singers share a blue songbook beneath a star-and-dreidel garland; the older man wears a blue kippah and green cardigan.
items.description: An older man and two younger singers gather around one open blue booklet. Their green, cream and plum clothing separates the figures beneath a string of blue paper stars and dreidel shapes.

items.title: Sharing Latkes and Sufganiyot
items.alt: Two adults and a child share latkes and jelly doughnuts at a round table, with blue kippot on the man and boy.
items.description: Forkfuls of latke lift above individual blue-rimmed plates as the three diners share a round wooden table. A large platter of crisp pancakes, a bowl of applesauce and sugar-dusted doughnuts fill the center.

items.title: Setting a Blue and White Hanukkah Table
items.alt: A woman in a plum apron places a blue-patterned plate on a dining table set with napkins, a hanukkiah and a folded paper star.
items.description: Blue and white plates and rolled cloth napkins surround an unlit nine-candle hanukkiah. The woman leans forward to place another plate between the wooden dining chairs, with a blue paper star near the runner.

items.title: Carrying Sufganiyot on a Copper Tray
items.alt: An older man in a blue kippah and olive waistcoat holds a copper tray of jelly doughnuts beside a decorated Hanukkah table.
items.description: Both hands support the shallow copper tray, whose handle carries a blue bow. The man’s gray mustache and olive waistcoat distinguish him beside the candleholder, gelt bowl and small dreidels on the side table.

items.title: Starting a Dreidel Spin
items.alt: Hands in blue wool cuffs reach toward a wooden dreidel and gold coins on a painted round board, with Hanukkah candles behind.
items.description: A decorated blue-and-gold dreidel turns above a round painted wooden board. One hand has just released its handle while the other waits nearby, with gold chocolate coins and a jeweled candleholder behind them.

items.title: Icing Star Cookies for Hanukkah
items.alt: A young baker in a blue kippah and hoodie pipes white icing onto a six-pointed star cookie at a blue wooden table.
items.description: The piping bag traces the edge of one star cookie on a lined wooden board. More cookies and a bowl of icing sit beside the baker, with an empty brass hanukkiah at the opposite end of the blue table.
